title: One Ship Lifted a 24,200-Tonne Oil Platform in a Single Piece

scenes.text: One ship lifted an entire oil platform at once.
It is called Pioneering Spirit, and its hull is almost four hundred metres long.
In 2017 it picked up a North Sea platform called Brent Delta.
The top section alone weighed twenty-four thousand two hundred tonnes.
Huge steel beams at the front lifted it clear of its legs.
Its maximum lift is forty-eight thousand tonnes. One ship.

description:
In 2017 the ship Pioneering Spirit lifted the 24,200-tonne top section of the Brent Delta platform off its legs in one piece.
Its maximum topside lift capacity is 48,000 tonnes.
What is the biggest machine you have ever seen? Comment below.
first_comment: 48,000 tonnes in one lift. What machine do you think is the biggest ever built?
